model_details.name: Aurynix Apex lead scoring model
model_details.task: Binary classification used as a ranking: probability that a new lead converts

intended_use.primary_use: Rank new leads so the sales (SDR) team calls the most likely buyers first, and split them into High / Medium / Low priority by team capacity.
intended_use.users: SDR team and sales managers, through Aurynix Pulse (CRM) or the Apex API
intended_use.prediction_moment: When the lead enters the queue, before any sales contact
out_of_scope: Deciding whether a person gets a product, price, or service
Credit, hiring, insurance, or any decision with legal or similar effect
Scoring leads after sales contact (post-contact fields are excluded by design)
Lead data from a different business or form without re-validation
Predicting revenue, deal size, or time to conversion

data.license: Listed as Unknown on Kaggle; used for research / portfolio only
data.final_training_data: All rows (train + validation + test) after evaluation
cleaning: Missing text filled with a 'Missing' category (missingness is informative)
Missing visit counts filled with fixed medians; outliers capped (visits 30)
Constant, near-constant, and ID columns dropped
known_issues: Single snapshot per lead, no timestamps: cannot prove when website activity was recorded
One company, one period: may not represent other businesses
About 22% of leads look identical to another lead (low-information leads)

features.notes: Country and City were dropped (weak signal). Occupation is used and may correlate with age or employment status.

pipeline: StandardScaler on numbers + OneHotEncoder on text (rare / unseen → infrequent)
algorithm.selection: Tied with LightGBM / XGBoost on 5-fold CV (PR-AUC 0.818); chosen for simplicity, explainability, and honest probabilities (ADR-003, ADR-004)
algorithm.explainability: Exact linear SHAP: weight × (value − average value), grouped into readable reasons per lead

segmentation.method: Capacity-based: top 20% High, next 30% Medium, rest Low

test_set.description: Held-out 20% (1,848 leads), used once; model fitted on train + validation

out_of_fold_all_rows.description: 5-fold out-of-fold predictions on all rows (final model setup)

risk_rating.rationale: Decision support for sales prioritization only: a person decides whom to call, Low leads still receive automated emails, no protected or location attributes are used, and no one is denied a product or service. Model risk (data representativeness, drift) is the main concern and is monitored.
risk_rating.regulatory_note: Likely a minimal-risk use case (marketing / sales prioritization). This is an engineering assessment, not a legal one.

risks.risk: Data not representative (one company, one period)
risks.mitigation: Re-validate on each client's data; drift monitoring (PSI)

risks.risk: Hidden leakage: Lead Add Form leads (92.5% convert) may be added by sales after a good call
risks.mitigation: Confirm the Lead Add Form process with the business; watch its share and conversion in production

risks.risk: Data and score drift (new channels, forms, campaigns)
risks.mitigation: PSI on features and scores; warning at 0.10, drift at 0.25

risks.risk: Feedback loop: only High leads get called, so labels favor them
risks.mitigation: Keep a small random-contact sample when outcomes are logged

risks.risk: Calibration bias: 0.5–0.6 scores convert ~10 pts more, 0.8–0.9 ~10 pts less than shown
risks.mitigation: Segments use rank, not probability; switch to isotonic if exact percentages matter

risks.risk: Indirect bias through occupation (e.g. students, unemployed ranked lower)
risks.mitigation: Human decides; Low leads still nurtured; review segment mix by occupation

limitations: Trained on 9,240 leads from one online-education company
Website activity may include visits after first contact (no timestamps)
Random split, not time-based: future performance may be lower if behavior changes
About 15% of buyers fall in the Low segment
Probabilities are approximate in the 0.5–0.9 range (see risks)

monitoring.metric: Population Stability Index per feature and on the score
retrain_when: New lead sources or forms appear
Real conversion outcomes show a drop in precision of the High segment
